age_band.note: A flat valley-floor lake at 1,017 m beside a car park, bus stop and climbing boulders; nothing on the shore limits age.

suitability.kid_note: A flat lakeside stop 2 km from Chamonix centre with a picnic area, public toilets and easy climbing boulders; the lake itself is the payoff, so no walking is needed.

stroller.note: No surface is published; the listings describe a flat natural site reached by car, bus or a 2 km walk. All-terrain until a person checks the shore path.

min_age.quote: Children under 3 years of age are not allowed to visit, and children under 5 are not recommended.

age_band.note: Our judgement, built on the operator's advice that under-5s are not recommended (quoted); the reason is the 2,800 m rise to 3,842 m in one ride. The band itself is ours, not a published band (RC).

suitability.kid_note: Under 3s are not allowed and under 5s are not recommended. The cable car climbs from 1,033 m to 3,842 m in about 20 minutes and the summit terraces are near or below freezing, so bring warm layers and keep the visit short if anyone feels unwell.

suitability.kid_note: A 20-minute rack railway to the Mer de Glace viewpoint at 1,913 m with restaurants and adapted toilets at the top. The ice cave is a separate step: a short gondola then about 200 metal stairs down and back up.

suitability.kid_note: The dam top (free, open mid-May to end of October) is the easy part, with a view to Mont Blanc. The dinosaur footprints are not a short visit: a 12.9 km, +845 m hike rated difficult (4 h 40), snow-free only from about mid-July.

age_band.note: For the dam viewpoint only. The footprint hike (12.9 km, +845 m) is over every under-10 ceiling in our rule.

age_band.note: About 200 metal stairs down from the gondola and the same back up, in glacier cold; a child under about 4 is likely carried both ways.

suitability.kid_note: Reached by the Mer de Glace gondola, then about 200 metal openwork stairs down and back up. The cave is cold; bring a warm layer. Not possible with a pushchair or wheelchair.

carrier_ok.note: No operator ban on carriers was found; a back carrier leaves hands free for the stair rails. Ask the operator.

age_band.note: Official 7 km and 4 h 15 one way, rated Moyenne; GPS tracks put the climb at about 800 m, over the 8-9 ceiling of 9 km and 500 m.

suitability.kid_note: The official route to the Aiguillette des Posettes starts at Le Tour, not the Col des Montets: many zigzags up to a ridge, 4 h 15 one way to Vallorcine. The Vallorcine gondola to the Col des Posettes shortens it when it runs.

carrier_ok.note: A long climb (about 800 m by GPS tracks) and a ridge to the top; too long for a carrying adult.

stroller.note: A mountain path with many hairpins.

suitability.kid_note: Official 7 km and 500 m up and down, rated difficult for its gradient, about 3 h return from the Flegere gondola. The lake is a natural turnaround and the hut serves drinks; the Cheserys ladder variant is exposed, so take the direct path with small children.

carrier_ok.note: The direct path from Flegere has no ladders; avoid the Cheserys ladder variant with a carrier.
